# Visual reference attribution

Source: https://github.com/wbr664393425-lgtm/scaffold-master
Retrieved: 2026-10-19
License: MIT (full upstream notice retained in LICENSE).

`tokens.original.css` and `materials.original.css` retain the upstream visual
references. `../../admin-appearance.css` adapts the pearl palette, surfaces,
radii and shadows for the existing static admin. The template application,
Java backend and GSAP are not bundled or run.

The data workspace also adapts the workspace main/secondary layout, readout-to-
trend-to-detail hierarchy, query/table/pagination pattern and grouped user board
described in upstream DESIGN.md and docs/admin-redesign-architecture.md.
